Messages.Author: Purple Kitty
Messages.Body:
David Borne (bo...@ouyang.ee.tulane.edu) wrote:

: I need some input. Heres the situation:

: someone gets blocked, combat ensues.
: no maneuvering, close range
: vampire 1 strikes body of sun (or burst of sunlight or any card that damages
: BOTH vampires in combat)
: vampire 2 plays skin of steel "prevents all damage from opponents strike" or
: something akin to that.

: so, Does Vampire 1 take damage?

A-yup! Vamp2 protected himself fully (unless Vamp1's card said "This
damage cannot be prevented"), but Vamp1 has NO protection at all. This is
why we do not use a Burst of Sunlight against a vamp with Fortitude. :-)
